patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Navigate into the 'CBM_win' folder, and then into the 'CBM-win32-x64' folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'CBM.tpatch' file from the downloaded patch archive into the 'CBM-win32-x64' folder mentioned above, alongside the games .exe. file It's working if: When you run the game, a message will appear saying that the patch was applied.
